tools.name: check_wallet_trust
tools.description: Recomputes the realized SOL profit and loss of a Solana wallet from its on-chain transaction history and returns a trust verdict. Returns: verdict (TRUSTED, NEUTRAL, UNTRUSTED, INSUFFICIENT, UNVERIFIABLE), a confidence level, realized profit/loss in SOL, the number of coins analyzed, stable reason c

tools.name: check_wallet_forensics
tools.description: Traces where a Solana wallet's funding came from and how old it is, using on-chain transfer history. Returns: origin classification (CEX_FUNDED, WALLET_FUNDED, UNKNOWN_ORIGIN, UNVERIFIABLE_ORIGIN), the funding transaction, wallet age, and a fresh_wallet flag.

tools.name: check_trade_cost
tools.description: Estimates what a trade of a given size would cost in a Solana token's main liquidity pool. Returns: expected slippage in percent, an estimated round-trip cost calibrated against measured live execution overhead, a recommended maximum size in SOL, pool liquidity, and a verdict (ACCEPTABLE_COST, ELEVA

tools.name: check_token_safety
tools.description: Analyzes structural risk of a Solana token from on-chain data: real-holder concentration with bonding-curve and liquidity-pool accounts excluded, presence of known sniper-bot addresses among early buyers, and a simulated buy/sell round trip to detect honeypot behavior. Returns: verdict (LOW_RISK, EL
